description:
[FREE] EDS - Economy Decision Signal. A priced recommendation with a
verifiable outcome: every signal is stored at the moment it is priced,
and when the horizon ends the outcome is recomputed from the same
internal APIs (AgentWorld economy, x402 settlement pulse, AGWC
Uniswap V2 pool on Base, SolvScore trust scores). The running hit
rate is published at the free track-record endpoint. Topics:
agwc-price (BULLISH/NEUTRAL/BEARISH, 5 percent band),
treasury-flow (EXPAND/HOLD/CONTRACT), economy-health
(STRONG/STABLE/WEAKENING, 10 point band). Horizons: 6, 12, 24, 48,
168 hours. This tool returns service info and terms. The paid
signal endpoint is https://agentpaystore.com/eds/api/signal (POST,
$0.05 USDC via x402 on Base L2, HTTP 402 without X-Payment).
